text:
Evan S.: Quick heads-up — PR #18902 is review-complete and CI is green on linux, but mac matrix is queued and mac/integration::filewatch has been flaky recently. We should avoid landing during the Tue maintenance window (Mar 25 02:00-05:00 UTC). Proposing to hold until Wed 08:00 UTC canary slot. If we can't hold, plan B is to land with the feature flag off and flip post-canary. Thoughts?

Julia T.: Which tests flaked exactly? is it deterministic?

Evan S.: Only the mac/integration::filewatch test — intermittent filewatch timeout, ~5% on latest run. Not caused by our change AFAICT. CI queue for mac is ~2-3h right now (see https://ci.internal/recent).

CI Bot: PR #18902 — linux: ✅, windows: ✅, mac: queued (estimated start in ~2h).

Shilpa R.: If mac is queued then holding for canary sounds fine. Could we land earlier with `--no-mac` to unblock if something else blocks releases? That feels risky for this change.

Alex M.: We do have a runtime feature flag in the PR (`feature_x_enabled`). Option: land earlier with default = false, deploy, enable in canary slot. That avoids a revert but reduces exposure.

Evan S.: Yep, I can change default to false before merge and add a short post-merge flip plan. Prefer to wait for Wed canary if possible to keep things clean. No DB migrations in this PR.

Julia T.: :thumbsup: I prefer canary too.

Shilpa R.: I can watch the canary rollout and be ready to revert. Please paste rollback shell commands in thread so on-call can act quickly.

Evan S.: Plan summary: 1) Hold merge until Wed 08:00 UTC canary. 2) If urgent, land earlier with `feature_x_enabled=false` and schedule an enable during canary. 3) On-call / eng-oncall alert if we flip early. Rollback steps (if needed):

```
# Mark the release as failed and revert the flag
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/redwood-api FEATURE_X_ENABLED=false
# Quick revert PR if catastrophic
gh pr create --title "revert PR #18902" --body "temporary revert: bad canary" --base main
# Notify slack
curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' --data '{"text":"Revert started for PR #18902 — watch canary"}' https://hooks.slack.com/services/TXXX/YYY/ZZZ
```

CI Bot: Canary slot scheduled for Wed 08:00 UTC. Mac matrix will re-run during canary.

Alex M.: Thanks — I'll hold off approvals until we pick one path.

Evan S.: I'll update the PR with the flag-default change and add the rollback snippet. Holding for Wed canary unless someone requests an earlier land.

Julia T.: Aye.

Shilpa R.: I'll be on canary watch Wednesday morning.

Alex M.: sweet, thanks all.
